text: The Globe: turn it with a finger to see the countries your coins come from lit in gold, tap a country to see your coins from there and the money it uses now and used before, and see which countries you have nothing from yet.
Legend now has a bottom bar with Collection, Globe, Quarters, Learn and Settings, and a Settings screen where you can change the theme, the text size and more.
